# m.stocks.filings.initial_insider_ownership

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Initial insider ownership statements (SEC Form 3), one row per reported holding.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.filings.initial_insider_ownership(symbols=None, *, issuer_cik=None, owner_cik=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.APPEND`, which appends each row it hasn't seen, identified by `AccessionNumber`, `OwnerCik`, `SecurityType`, `SecurityTitle`, `DirectOrIndirect`, `NatureOfOwnership`, `ExercisePrice`, `ExerciseDate` and `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers whose filings to return; None, the default, for every filing. |
| `issuer_cik` | The issuing company's SEC CIK, as text with its leading zeros, or a sequence of them; None, the default, for every issuer. |
| `owner_cik` | The reporting owner's SEC CIK, one or a sequence, as `issuer_cik`; None, the default, for every owner. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first filing date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last filing date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | The field to sort by, such as `"filing_date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: `form_type`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Initial Insider Ownership (Form 3) (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. |
| `AccessionNumber` | String | Unique SEC accession number for the filing (e.g., '0001209191-25-012345'). |
| `Aff10b5One` | boolean | Whether the transaction was made pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. |
| `DateOfOriginalSubmission` | String | Date of the original filing submission for amendment filings (3/A). Null for initial filings (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `DirectOrIndirect` | String | Whether ownership is direct ('D') or indirect ('I'). |
| `ExerciseDate` | String | Date exercisable for derivative securities (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `ExercisePrice` | double | Exercise or conversion price of derivative securities in USD. |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `FilingUrl` | String | Direct URL to the filing on the SEC EDGAR website. |
| `Footnotes` | String | List of footnotes from the filing that are relevant to this row, each with an id and description. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. |
| `FormType` | String | SEC form type ('3' for initial filing, '3/A' for amendments). |
| `IsDirector` | boolean | Whether the reporting owner is a director of the issuer. |
| `IsOfficer` | boolean | Whether the reporting owner is an officer of the issuer. |
| `IsOther` | boolean | Whether the reporting owner has another relationship with the issuer. |
| `IsTenPercentOwner` | boolean | Whether the reporting owner holds 10% or more of a class of equity securities. |
| `IssuerCik` | String | SEC Central Index Key of the issuer company (10 digits, zero-padded). |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of the issuer company as reported in the filing. |
| `NatureOfOwnership` | String | Nature of indirect ownership (e.g., 'By Trust', 'By Spouse'). |
| `NotSubjectToSection16` | boolean | Whether the reporting owner is not subject to Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act. |
| `OfficerTitle` | String | Title of the officer, if the reporting owner is an officer. |
| `OwnerCik` | String | SEC Central Index Key of the reporting owner (10 digits, zero-padded). |
| `OwnerName` | String | Name of the reporting owner (individual or entity). |
| `PeriodOfReport` | String | Date of the event triggering the filing (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `Remarks` | String | Additional remarks included in the filing. |
| `SecurityTitle` | String | Title or description of the security (e.g., 'Common Stock', 'Stock Option'). |
| `SecurityType` | String | Type of security ('non-derivative' or 'derivative'). |
| `SharesOwned` | double | Number of shares beneficially owned. |
| `Tickers` | String[] | A list of ticker symbols for the issuer company. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes. |
| `UnderlyingSecurityShares` | double | Number of underlying shares for derivative holdings. |
| `UnderlyingSecurityTitle` | String | Title of the underlying security for derivative holdings. |
| `IssuerTradingSymbol` | String | The issuer's trading symbol, as the filing reports it. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
